Scrivener

2024
Text-based role-playing game played on Discord, custom AI storyteller

Scrivener is a text-based role-playing game played on Discord, made for The Creepin’ Illiberalist Curriculum by Weird Economies. In a near future shaped by illiberal power, the last remnants of the left have banded together as a DAO, a decentralized autonomous organization with horizontal governance and a shared treasury. Players join factions with their own politics, from Marxists and Anarchists to Eschatologist Accelerationists and the Deep State, and must make proposals and respond to crises together, while a custom AI storyteller writes the consequences of each decision into the story in real time. Part Dungeons & Dragons, part governance experiment, the game makes the hard part of solidarity, deciding together, its central mechanic.
